east-indies.name: The East Indies
east-indies.blurb: The Portuguese Estado da India: Goa, the Malabar coast, and the road onward to Macao and the Far East. The classic destination of the petitions.

china.name: China
china.blurb: The scholar-mission of Ricci's successors: slow, learned, and comparatively open. A favored destination in the petitions.

japan.name: Japan
japan.blurb: A forbidden mission under the Tokugawa persecution. Petitioners ask for Japan knowing entry means hiding and likely martyrdom.

india.name: India
india.blurb: The Malabar and Fishery coasts, Madurai and the Mughal court: the working heart of the Portuguese Asian missions.

paraguay.name: Paraguay
paraguay.blurb: The reductions of Paraguay: frontier missions among the Guarani, far up the rivers of South America.

brazil.name: Brazil
brazil.blurb: Portuguese Brazil: coastal colleges at Bahia and the aldeia missions of the interior.

aethiopia.name: Aethiopia
aethiopia.blurb: The highlands of Ethiopia, where Jesuits labored at the court of the negus in the 1620s before their expulsion in 1633.

england.name: England
england.blurb: A hidden mission under penal laws: priests cross covertly from the continent to serve recusant Catholics.

west-indies.name: The West Indies
west-indies.blurb: The Spanish Caribbean: early missions and colleges on the islands and the mainland coast.

peru.name: Peru
peru.blurb: The viceroyalty of Peru: Lima's colleges and the Andean missions beyond.

chile.name: Chile
chile.blurb: The far southern frontier: missions among the Mapuche on the edge of the Spanish empire.

vietnam.name: Vietnam (Cochinchina)
vietnam.blurb: Cochinchina: the southern Vietnamese kingdom. Jesuits arrived in the 1610s; Alexandre de Rhodes will come in 1624.

tonkin.name: Tonkin
tonkin.blurb: Tonkin: the northern Vietnamese kingdom. A harder field than Cochinchina, opened later.

siam.name: Siam
siam.blurb: Siam: the kingdom of Ayutthaya. Portuguese traders know it; no Jesuit mission yet.

cambodia.name: Cambodia
cambodia.blurb: Cambodia: the Khmer kingdom at Lovek. A brief Jesuit presence; a frontier for the bold.

congo.name: Congo
congo.blurb: The Kongo kingdom: an old Christian kingdom, its Jesuit mission struggles.

angola.name: Angola
angola.blurb: Luanda: Portugal's African stronghold. A Jesuit college stands; the interior awaits.

mozambique.name: Mozambique
mozambique.blurb: Mozambique Island: gateway to the Zambezi. Fever country; few survive long.

madagascar.name: Madagascar
madagascar.blurb: Madagascar: the great island. Brief attempts; no lasting mission yet.

new-granada.name: New Granada
new-granada.blurb: New Granada: Cartagena and the interior. Jesuits arrived; the mission is young.

quito.name: Quito
quito.blurb: Quito: high in the Andes. A province will be erected in the 1620s.

mexico.name: Mexico
mexico.blurb: New Spain: Mexico City and the northern frontier. The great province of the north.

huronia.name: Huronia (New France)
huronia.blurb: The Huron country, north of the St. Lawrence. The French have a foothold at Quebec (1608); the Jesuits will come in 1626. A harsh frontier.

philippines.name: Philippines
philippines.blurb: The Spanish Philippines. Jesuits arrived in 1581; Manila is a thriving entrepôt. Reachable via New Spain or the Indian Ocean.

guatemala.name: Guatemala
guatemala.blurb: The Captaincy General of Guatemala. Jesuits arrived in 1607; Antigua is the center. A Spanish colonial frontier.
